children: Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT) reported a $135B noncash gain from its OpenAI stake amid a reporting reorg into Agents & Infra and Devices & Consumer, flagged workforce cuts and legal and regulatory risks over AI use, while banks raise targets and talks with Moonshot signal cloud AI monetization.
Previous Week Recap
Microsoft Reports $135B Noncash Gain
: Microsoft reports a $135B noncash gain from its OpenAI stake (about 27% as-converted) after OpenAI’s 2025 restructure; tagged as accounting valuation, not cash revenue or operating income.
Microsoft Reorganizes Reporting, FY27 Guidance
: Microsoft (MSFT) reorganized reporting into Agents & Infra and Devices & Consumer, restated FY26, guided FY27 Q1 revenue $89.85–$90.95B (Azure quarterly revenue to be reported), capex >$50B.
MSFT Named Defendant in Copyright Suits
: MSFT named defendant in NY copyright suits alleging use of paid newspaper articles to train Copilot and Bing AI; plaintiffs seek damages and destruction of alleged infringing datasets and models.
Microsoft Updates Financial Framework
: Microsoft (MSFT) said it will update its financial framework to reflect AI’s impact on strategy and product integration; changes take effect with Q1 earnings this fall.
Bank Of America Raises MSFT Target
: Bank of America kept Buy on Microsoft (MSFT) and raised its price target to $600, citing faster Azure cloud growth and stronger AI investment returns—key trading drivers for the stock.
EU Court Upholds Edge Exemption
: EU General Court upheld the EC's 2024 decision exempting Microsoft Edge from DMA gatekeeper rules; court found Edge not a key gateway for businesses, so Edge avoids DMA obligations.
Microsoft July Workforce Cuts
: Microsoft (MSFT) disclosed July workforce cuts: about 4,800 global layoffs and earlier voluntary buyout offers to roughly 9,000 U.S. employees. Key data for traders: scope and timing of reductions.
Copilot As Orchestration Layer
: Microsoft (MSFT) Copilot may serve as an orchestration layer, routing tasks to frontier models by cost, performance and risk—useful if deployment frictions limit access to top models.
Moonshot AI Revenue-Share Talks
: Moonshot AI is in early talks with Microsoft (MSFT) on revenue-sharing to host Moonshot’s Kimi K3 AI model on Microsoft’s cloud, signaling potential cloud hosting partnership.
Regulators Warn AI Cyber Risk
: Regulators warned AI-driven cyberattacks could pose systemic risk due to dependence on major tech providers; Microsoft (MSFT) shares dipped about 0.6% after those remarks.
